content: The continuous use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems is linked to a significant reduction in anxiety related to fluctuations in blood glucose levels. This technology also contributes to a decrease in the risk of diabetes-related complications. By providing real-time feedback on glucose levels, CGM enables users to make prompt and informed lifestyle adjustments. This fosters a sense of control and empowerment, ultimately enhancing the overall quality of life for both individuals living with diabetes and their caregivers.
